name: python-session-26-tuples-and-sequences
description: Base template for NxtWave session slide decks: the shared kit (tokens, slide types, player, harnesses) plus a content-free base deck.

scripts.build: npm run gen && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:html: npm run gen && tsc -b && vite build -c vite.singlefile.config.ts && node scripts/inline-assets.mjs && node scripts/inline-fonts.mjs
scripts.build:review: npm run gen && vite build -c vite.review.config.ts
